notes.proposed: TFV-first sparse-state + differentiable continuous MPC. Priority PFV is soft/diagnostic rather than a hard admission gate.
notes.no_control: No-supervisory-RTC: native [CONTROLS] disabled and no Python writes; passive/local device physics remain.
notes.internal_rtc: Original event INP with native [CONTROLS] enabled and no Python setting writes.
notes.auto_rbc: Causal automatically parameterized local rule-based control. Actuator-adjacent current node depths are normalized by INP design max depth; high upstream filling opens the link and severe downstream filling suppresses discharge. No forecast or event-specific tuning.
notes.efd: Storage-aware Equal Filling Degree control. Current storage filling degrees are compared globally; more-filled storages receive stronger outgoing settings so storage utilization is equalized. No forecast or event-specific tuning.
notes.all_open: Diagnostic extreme: all eligible settings commanded to 1.0 from the common first control decision.
notes.all_closed: Diagnostic extreme: all eligible settings commanded to 0.0 from the common first control decision.

excluded_formal_strategies.hold: Debug-only because a frozen first-decision readback can collapse toward No-control.
